Title: Bible verses about fear
Description: “After these events, the word of the LORD came to Abram in a vision: Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your very great reward.” (Genesis 15:1) Bible verses about fear, from the 'do not be afraid' commands to danger, the future and death. Each group has a short reflection on who said it and why.

Title: App para memorizar versículos de la Biblia: uno cada mañana al despertar
Description: “En mi corazón he guardado tus dichos, para no pecar contra ti.” (Salmos 119:11) Cómo funciona una app para memorizar versículos con alarma: Bible Verse Alarm te pide armar un versículo cada mañana. Qué hace y qué no hace.

Title: A Christian alarm clock that wakes you up with Scripture
Description: “In the morning, O LORD, You hear my voice; at daybreak I lay my plea before You and wait in expectation.” (Psalms 5:3) Bible Verse Alarm is a Christian alarm clock for iPhone. It keeps ringing until you complete a short Bible verse, so your first minute goes to God's Word.

Title: Alarma cristiana con versículos: despierta con la Palabra de Dios
Description: “Dios, Dios mío eres tú: levantaréme a ti de mañana: mi alma tiene sed de ti, mi carne te desea, en tierra de sequedad y transida sin aguas;” (Salmos 63:1) Bible Verse Alarm es una alarma cristiana para iPhone: sigue sonando hasta que completas un versículo de la Biblia Reina-Valera 1909.

Title: How to read the Bible every morning
Description: “In the morning, O LORD, You hear my voice; at daybreak I lay my plea before You and wait in expectation.” (Psalms 5:3) A simple plan for reading the Bible each morning: start with five minutes, pick one place to read, tie it to waking up, and what to do when you miss a day.

Title: A morning devotional app that gets you to Scripture first
Description: “In the morning, O LORD, You hear my voice; at daybreak I lay my plea before You and wait in expectation.” (Psalms 5:3) Bible Verse Alarm is an iPhone alarm that puts Scripture in your first minute, so your quiet time starts before the scroll. What it does and doesn't do.

Title: Una app devocional para la mañana: empieza el día con un versículo
Description: “Oh Jehová, de mañana oirás mi voz; de mañana me presentaré a ti, y esperaré.” (Salmos 5:3) Una app para empezar el día con la Biblia: la alarma de Bible Verse Alarm no se apaga hasta que completas un versículo. Qué hace y qué no hace.
